name: dev-AI-plugins
description: Reusable skills, rules, commands, and agents for Claude Code and Cursor.

plugins.name: base-dev-kit
plugins.description: Honesty and security rules always applied, plus on-demand skills for clean code, git workflow, and testing principles — applicable to any language or stack.

plugins.name: frontend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and MCP servers for React 19 Feature-Sliced Design apps: TypeScript, shadcn/ui, Tailwind, react-query, react-hook-form + zod, react-i18next, and Vitest.

plugins.name: pptx-dev-kit
plugins.description: Create a 16:9 PowerPoint from a brief via a checked-in layout engine, or edit an existing .pptx in place via OOXML.

plugins.name: agent-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and agents for building production TypeScript/Node AI agents with the OpenAI SDK via OpenRouter, @openai/agents or LangGraph.js, and RAG pipelines with hybrid search and reranking.

plugins.name: backend-dev-kit
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and agents for building production Node.js backends with Express 5, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, Zod, and Vitest.

plugins.name: spec-dev-kit
plugins.description: Multi-agent pipeline that turns raw requirements in .spec/context/ into a validated, human-approved hybrid YAML+Markdown spec — requirements register with coverage, roles, permissions, rules, state machines, and a step-by-step delivery plan with per-slice build briefs — read by html-generator-kit, feature-dev-kit, backend-dev-kit, agent-dev-kit, and both orchestrators.

plugins.name: html-generator-kit
plugins.description: Turns a validated spec-dev-kit spec into a clickable Alpine.js multi-page HTML prototype (CDN-free for styling and scripting — Alpine.js is vendored; only Google Fonts loads from a CDN). A provided theme, brand, style guide, mockup, or layout is binding; ui-ux-pro-max supplies the design direction only when none is provided. Headless-browser verified before the skill-owned review gate.

plugins.name: feature-dev-kit
plugins.description: Hub-and-spoke factory that builds one React Feature-Sliced Design feature per run (nested screen-tasks share the branch and commit) from a spec-dev-kit spec and optional html prototype, through architecture-audit, quality gates, and a skill-owned human review. Never opens a pull request.

plugins.name: frontend-orchestrator-kit
plugins.description: Frontend-only sequencer: spec-dev-kit to author a spec, html-generator-kit to prototype it, then feature-dev-kit once per feature (nested screen-tasks share that call) against a persisted, resumable checklist. Use app-orchestrator-kit /orchestrate-app for the full-stack dispatcher.

plugins.name: app-orchestrator-kit
plugins.description: Full-stack app dispatcher: analyzes an approved spec-dev-kit spec and optional html-generator-kit prototype, then runs backend-dev-kit, agent-dev-kit, and frontend-orchestrator-kit only when needed, against a persisted work-plan.
